title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to provide for matters delegated by the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 2 (Application for approval, etc. in cases not deemed to be a release) Applications and approvals under Article 5 (3) of the Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall use the Application for Approval to Defer the Application of Deemed Release and the corresponding Approval in Form 1. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007; Mar. 6, 2015>
[Title amended on Mar. 6, 2015]

Article 3 Deleted. <Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 4 (Report of tax base) A report under Article 12 (1) of the Decree shall use the Tax Base Return for Taxable Articles in Form 4.

Article 5 (Application, etc. for special treatment of blended oil, etc. at oil reservoirs) An application for special treatment or an application to amend such application under Article 13-2 (2) of the Decree shall use the Application (Application for Amendment) for Special Treatment of Blended Oil, etc. at Oil Reservoirs in Form 5.
[This Article added on Feb. 28, 2012]

Article 6 (Applications, etc. for approval of release without tax payment or under tax exemption)
(1) Applications and approvals under Article 15 (1) or Article 22 (1) of the Decree (limited to cases of conditional exemption) shall use the Application for Approval of Release without Payment of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (under Conditional Exemption), the corresponding Approval and the corresponding Notice in Form 6. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>
(2) Applications and approvals under Article 19 (1) of the Decree shall use the Application for Approval of Release Exempt from Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax for Export (Military Supply) and the corresponding Approval in Form 7. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>
(3) Applications and approvals under Article 22 (1) of the Decree (limited to cases of unconditional exemption) shall use the Application for Approval of Release under Unconditional Exemption from Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax and the corresponding Approval in Form 8. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 7 (Report and certification of entry) Reports and certification under Article 17 (1) and (2) of the Decree shall use the Report of Entry of Articles without Payment of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (under Tax Exemption), the corresponding Application for Certification and the corresponding Certificate in Form 9. The Written Verification of Entry of Goods under Article 17 (2) 1 of the Decree and the aircraft loading permit under subparagraph 3 of that paragraph shall use documents prescribed by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service, and the fuel supply statement under subparagraph 2 of that paragraph shall use the Statement of Supply of Tax-Exempt Fuel for Foreign-Going Vessels and Deep-Sea Fishing Vessels in Form 9-2. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007; Feb. 23, 2013>

Article 8 (Application for approval of destruction or loss, etc.)
(1) Applications and approvals under Article 18 (1) of the Decree shall use the Application for Approval of Destruction or Loss of Articles Released without Payment of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (under Tax Exemption) and the corresponding Approval in Form 10. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>
(2) Certification under Article 18 (2) of the Decree shall use the Application for Certification of Destruction or Loss of Articles Released without Payment of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (under Tax Exemption) and the corresponding Certificate in Form 11. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 9 (Notification, etc. of sales of petroleum products for diplomatic missions)
(1) Notification under Article 20 (2) of the Decree shall use the Notice of Sales of Petroleum Products for Diplomatic Missions in Form 12. <Amended on Apr. 1, 2011>
(2) Reports and applications under Article 20 (3) and the proviso to Article 20 (4) of the Decree shall use the Report of Sales of Petroleum Products for Diplomatic Missions and Application for Credit (Refund) of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax in Form 13. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007; Apr. 1, 2011>
[Title amended on Apr. 1, 2011]

Article 10 (Certification of articles for tax-exempt purposes) Certification under the subparagraphs of Article 22 (2) of the Decree shall use the Application for Certification of Articles for Purposes Exempt from Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax and the corresponding Certificate in Form 14. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 11 (Report of use of petroleum products for tax-exempt purposes) Reports under Article 23 (1) 2 (a) and (b) of the Decree shall use the Report of Use of Petroleum Products for Tax-Exempt Purposes in Form 15, and verification shall use the Application for Verification of Use of Petroleum Products for Tax-Exempt Purposes and the corresponding Written Verification in Form 16.

Article 12 (Application for approval of disposal of tax-exempt articles, etc.) Applications and approvals under Article 23 (3) of the Decree shall use the Application for Approval of Disposal of Articles Exempt from Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax and the corresponding Approval in Form 17. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>

Article 13 (Applications for credit and refund, etc.)
(1) An application under Article 24 (1) of the Decree shall use the Application for Credit (Refund) of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax in Form 18, and certification that traffic, energy and environment tax has already been paid or will be paid shall use the Application for Certification of the Fact of Assessment (Payment) of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax and the corresponding Certificate in Form 19. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007>
(2) The detailed statements prescribed in Article 24 (2) 1 and 2 of the Decree shall use the Detailed Statement of Taxable Articles Used in Form 20.

Article 14 (Report of return of taxable articles, etc.) Reports and verification under Article 24 (4) of the Decree shall use the Report of Return of Taxable Articles and Application for Verification (Written Verification) in Form 21.

Article 15 (Reports of opening or closure of business, etc.)
(1) Reports under Article 25 (1) or (3) or the main text of Article 25 (4) of the Decree shall use the Report of Opening (Change or Closure) of a Business Manufacturing Taxable Articles in Form 22. <Amended on Apr. 5, 2007; Apr. 1, 2011>
(2) A person intending to file a report on a business-unit basis under Article 18 (3) or (4) of the Act shall submit the report under paragraph (1), accompanied by the Detailed Statement of Subsidiary Places of Business of a Person Filing a Report for Application on a Business-Unit Basis in the Attached Schedule to Form 22. <Added on Apr. 1, 2011>
(3) A report under Article 25 (5) of the Decree shall use the Report of Conversion to Taxation on a Manufacturing-Place Basis in Form 23. <Added on Mar. 14, 2014>

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 1954, Dec. 31, 1993>
(1) (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 1994.
(2) (Transitional measures concerning forms) For articles that were subject to special consumption tax under the Special Consumption Tax Act before these Rules enter into force and fall within the articles subject to traffic tax under the Traffic Tax Act, reports prepared and submitted in respect of those taxable articles using forms prescribed in the former Enforcement Rules of the Special Consumption Tax Act at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to have been prepared and submitted using forms prescribed in these Rules.
(3) (Transitional measures concerning reports of return) Articles released under the Special Consumption Tax Act before these Rules enter into force that fall within the articles subject to traffic tax under the Traffic Tax Act and are returned after these Rules enter into force shall be regarded as returned articles under the Traffic Tax Act, and a report of their return shall be filed using the form prescribed in these Rules.
(4) (Amendment of another statute) The Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on National Taxes are amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 12, "Forms 6 through 8 of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Consumption Tax Act for special consumption tax" is replaced by "Forms 6 through 8 of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Consumption Tax Act for special consumption tax, and Forms 4 and 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Traffic Tax Act for traffic tax".

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 559, Mar. 26, 1996>
(1) (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on July 1, 1996.
(2) (Applicability) These Rules shall apply beginning with the first taxable articles released from a manufacturing place or declared for import after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDUM (Ordinance Partially Amending the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Contracts to Which the State Is a Party and Other Rules for Shared Use of Administrative Information and Reduction of Documents) <Ordinance No. 512, Jul. 5, 2006>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 523, Aug. 30, 2006>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 552, Apr. 5, 2007>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 6, Mar. 14, 2008>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 202, Apr. 1, 2011>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation; provided that the amended provisions of Article 15, Form 22 and the Attached Schedule to Form 22 shall enter into force on July 1, 2011.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions concerning forms shall apply beginning with the first reports filed or documents submitted after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 271, Feb. 28, 2012>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation; provided that the amended provisions of Form 4 and Attached Schedule 1 to Form 4 shall enter into force on July 1, 2012.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions concerning forms shall apply beginning with the first reports filed or documents submitted after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 335, Feb. 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on April 1, 2013.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions concerning forms shall apply to reports filed or documents submitted after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 416, Mar. 14, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions of Article 15 shall apply to reports filed after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDA (Ordinance Partially Amending the Enforcement Rules of the Individual Consumption Tax Act and Other Rules for Personal Information Protection) <Ordinance No. 424, May 26, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional measures concerning forms) Forms in use under the former provisions at the time these Rules enter into force shall continue to be used, but the portions in which resident registration numbers are deleted or replaced by dates of birth under these Rules shall be deleted or revised for use.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 474, Mar. 6, 2015>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions of Form 1 shall apply to applications for approval filed after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 666, Mar. 19, 2018>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 779, Mar. 13, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions concerning forms shall apply to reports filed after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 837, Mar. 16, 2021>
Article 1 (Enforcement date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability concerning forms) The amended provisions concerning forms shall apply to documents submitted after these Rules enter into force.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 972, Mar. 20, 2023>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 1121, Mar. 21, 2025>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation; provided that the amended provisions of Form 9-2 shall enter into force on April 1, 2025.
